scripts.deploy:
npm run package && node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; const {execSync}=require('child_process'); const vsix='out/everscript-'+v+'.vsix'; console.log('Installing '+vsix+'...'); try { execSync('code --install-extension '+vsix+' --force', {stdio:'inherit'}); } catch(e) { console.error('
ERROR: code CLI not found or install failed.'); console.error('Fix: add VS Code to PATH via Command Palette: Shell Command: Install code in PATH'); process.exit(1); } const out=execSync('code --list-extensions 2>&1').toString(); if(!out.includes('rbin.everscript')) { console.error('
ERROR: extension installed but rbin.everscript not found in extension list.'); console.error('Installed output was: '+out); process.exit(1); } console.log('

everscript.repoPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the Everscript repository root. When set, the extension auto-fills `compilerPath`, `pythonPath`, `inDirectory`, `patchesDirectory`, and `romPath` if those values are still empty.

everscript.compilerPath.markdownDescription: Override: absolute path to `everscript.py` or a compiled binary. Auto-filled from `repoPath` when empty.

everscript.pythonPath.markdownDescription: Override: absolute path to the Python interpreter. Auto-filled from `<repoPath>/.venv/bin/python3` when empty.

everscript.inDirectory.markdownDescription: Path to the `in/` directory containing `.evs` source files. Used for static analysis (scope detection, room tree, `#include` resolution). Auto-filled from `repoPath` when empty, otherwise defaults to `<workspace>/in`.

everscript.patchesDirectory.markdownDescription: Path to the `patches/` directory. Used both for active-patch detection and as the default compiler `--patches` directory. Auto-filled from `repoPath` when empty, otherwise defaults to `<workspace>/patches`.

everscript.romPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Secret of Evermore ROM (`.smc`, no header). Used by the Scaling tab and the Rooms tab ROM-backed vanilla/script readers. Auto-filled from `repoPath` when empty, otherwise defaults to `<workspace>/Secret of Evermore (U) [!].smc`.

everscript.snesCorePath.markdownDescription: Path to a custom `snes9x2005-wasm` Emscripten `.js` build (for example `debugger/core/snes9x2005-wasm/snes9x_2005.js`). The matching `.wasm` file must be in the same directory. Leave empty to use the bundled vanilla core at `debugger/core/snes9x2005-wasm-vanilla/snes9x_2005.js`.

everscript.cdl.enabled.markdownDescription: Start the emulator's CDL recorder automatically for every ROM. It records which ROM bytes run as code or are read as data, who calls each function, and who (instruction or script) reads or writes each WRAM address. Everything stays in memory; the per-ROM library in the extension's global storage is written only when something changed (1 minute after the last change, at most every 5 minutes, and at once on pause / stop) and merges across sessions. The CDL tab in the emulator's bottom bar can also switch it on for one session.

everscript.cdl.scriptExcludes.markdownDescription: WRAM ranges (hex offsets into `$7E0000`, `start-end`) never attributed to script instructions by the CDL recorder. Defaults skip direct-page scratch and the stack (`0000-01FF`) and the script temporaries, slot table and run list (`2834-2FFF`), which every script touches.

everscript.tas.autoRecord.markdownDescription: Record the emulator's joypad input of every frame, from power-on, into a time-stamped `.evsmv` file (one per ROM boot or replay). Sessions in which no button was pressed by hand are discarded. Recordings appear in the emulator's REPLAYS tab and can be replayed frame-exactly.

everscript.tas.recordingsDirectory.markdownDescription: Folder for input recordings (`.evsmv`). Empty: `tas-recordings` in the extension's global storage (REPLAYS tab > open folder).

everscript.patchesPath.markdownDescription: Legacy alias for the compiler `--patches` directory.
everscript.patchesPath.deprecationMessage: Use Everscript: Patches Directory instead. This setting is kept only for backward compatibility.

everscript.mcp.enabled.markdownDescription: Serve the read-only `soe://` file system to AI clients over MCP at `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp` (localhost only). VS Code's chat (Copilot) gets it automatically; Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Antigravity read `.mcp.json`, `.gemini/settings.json` and `.agents/mcp_config.json` in the repo.

everscript.mcp.port.markdownDescription: Port of the `soe://` MCP server. Copilot follows this setting; keep `.mcp.json`, `.gemini/settings.json` and `.agents/mcp_config.json` in sync. With several VS Code windows, the first one to start serves it.
